svg.title: Moving the battery changes aircraft balance
svg.desc: Actual Bronco tricopter layout, an illustrative 50 millimeter battery move forward shifts CG 7.2 millimeters forward. Total mass is 1323 grams.

svg.aria-label: Bronco tricopter in hover configuration. The highlighted battery and gold center of gravity move together.

g.text: Geometry from the aircraft definition · translucent fuselage
190 g battery ÷ 1323 g aircraft × 50 mm movement. Total mass is unchanged.
Illustrative installation, not a safe-CG or clearance assessment. Try the interactive version in the RCForge docs.
